name: comp-582
title: Icon Nav With Language Select
blurb: Icon-only navbar with language selector and theme toggle.
description: Header with icon nav links, language select dropdown, and theme toggle. Icons shown with tooltips on desktop; text labels on mobile.
use_when: Global apps needing language/theme controls at the top with a compact icon-based nav.
a11y: Icons have aria-label. Tooltips on hover (desktop). Theme toggle is keyboard-accessible. Language selector has aria-label.
